## Version impact

Platform: `MAJOR` / `MINOR` / `PATCH` / `NONE`

Changed services and impacts:

## Security-sensitive areas

- [ ] Authentication, authorization, sessions, or 2FA
- [ ] Uploads, evidence, personal data, or cryptography
- [ ] AI tools, agents, prompts, or external calls
- [ ] Database schema or migrations
- [ ] Infrastructure, containers, workflows, or secrets
- [ ] None of the above

Security-sensitive changes require two approvals, including a security maintainer.

## Verification

- [ ] Task file allowlist passed
- [ ] Formatting, types, and relevant tests passed
- [ ] Secret and targeted SAST scans passed without broad suppressions
- [ ] Dependency and license changes were reviewed
- [ ] Critical and High findings are resolved
- [ ] Medium and Low findings have an issue, owner, due date, justification, and approval

Commands and results:

## Staging milestone

- [ ] This change does not complete a runnable feature milestone
- [ ] `ready-for-staging` was approved and isolated staging evidence is attached
- [ ] A new commit has not invalidated the attached staging evidence

## Public disclosure

- [ ] No credentials, customer data, internal hosts, private findings, runtime output, or historical Git metadata are included
- [ ] New files have correct SPDX and third-party attribution information
